routing_warnings.description: The reported plumbing leak is concrete runtime-failure evidence for the leak-free liquid-containment Requirement.
The concern is preservation of consistency and frothiness through the dispensing path, not creation of the mixed beverage result.
The proposed gravity-based method concerns dispensing without degrading consistency and should not be treated as a change to mixing quality.
The concrete runtime failure in this message is a plumbing leak and should be recorded under the leak-free liquid-containment Requirement rather than continuous-operation reliability.
The successful spin test is narrower than continuous-operation reliability; the requested multi-minute liquid test is not reported as completed in this source.
The request for a gravity-based dispensing method concerns the dispensing mechanism and beverage handling rather than external spout geometry.
The measured 5 3/4-inch clearance concerns cup clearance provided by the raised platform rather than the spout's custom shape or pouring orientation.
The observed plumbing leak concerns liquid containment rather than spout geometry.
The cracked fitting identifies the cause of the plumbing-integrity failure and does not change the spout geometry Requirement.
The message primarily identifies the absence of a dedicated on/off control and belongs to the master power control Requirement rather than changing the 120V supply architecture.
The client's preference for the rendering-style power button and K markings concerns visual styling rather than master power behavior.
The requested light around the power button is an accent-lighting requirement rather than a change to master power behavior.
The decision to use smaller bowls changes bowl capacity and form rather than the enclosure Requirement.
The separate platform for cup clearance is an independently defined structure rather than part of the main enclosure form.

The light around the power button belongs to the LED accent-lighting Requirement.

The client approves the finalized BOM for ordering; this primarily concerns the BOM deliverable rather than independently changing the V1 component strategy.
The message clarifies that the parts list is finalized and the milestone is moving to layout, wiring, and integration; it does not clearly change the off-the-shelf component strategy.
The tool-free whisk-detachment clause belongs to the separate quick-whisk-removal Requirement; only the whisk-positioning clause is retained here.
The concern that the proposed spout would reduce matcha consistency and frothiness concerns dispensing-flow quality rather than valve actuation.
The clean, controlled, non-sputtering pour criteria concern dispensing-flow quality; the solenoid approach itself is reaffirmed rather than changed.
The observed plumbing leak is a runtime failure of liquid containment, not a failure of button-activated valve control.

The requirement that 12-ounce cups fit beneath the spouts also establishes the independently tracked cup-clearance behavior.

The cursive K request applies to the dispense buttons rather than the machine placards.

missing_requirement_candidates.description: The client identifies cleaning procedures as potentially valuable long-term documentation, which is an engineering-artifact concern separate from physical food-path cleanability.
